character.name: Cat (short for Catwithamask)
character.appearance: Cat has blond shoulder-length hair with a greenish streak on her left side. This hair style was inspired by my (the artist) own style back in early 2019. The goo is made out of purple glitter and the stone on the left cheek represents a tear. Because art is pain. The bandana has a very complex muster, so I rarely draw it. She mostly wears a pink/purpleish long sleeves shirt, soft blue pants and pink socks.
character.personality: Cat has a very neutral chaotic personality. She incoorporates my joking side and my artistic freedom. She is my online Persona.
character.backstory: The mask was created in 2018 with a good friend. Originally I had a very creepy one I made with fake blood on it. Thankfully my friend stopped me mid track and made it more aesthetic. The name "Catwithamask" came to be because the mask we chose in the store was a cat mask and because I like cats.The bandana is to cover the rest of the face, since the mask covers only the top half.
